# `agency_lifecycle_stats`

**Time to final rule by agency**

Estimated days to a final rule by agency and stratum, using Aalen–Johansen cumulative incidence with withdrawal as a competing outcome and 95% intervals. Cells pool all proposal years; fewer than 30 rules suppress estimates. NULL quartiles mean the estimate never reaches that probability. Routine families exist only for FAA, EPA and USCG. Each docketed proceeding counts separately, including proposals naming several dockets. Cohort estimates require filtering and recomputing the underlying lifecycles.

**Coverage.** Derived from `rulemaking_lifecycles` with a survival outcome, every proposal year together (no cohort window), per `agency_code` as the proceeding states it (no department roll-up: HHS, CMS and FDA are separate cells). A cell covering fewer than 30 rules is suppressed. *(measured 2026-09-27)*

**Data quality.** On 2026-09-27 every unsuppressed estimate equalled R's multi-state `survfit`.

- **Parquet file:** `agency_lifecycle_stats.parquet`, in the snapshot that `materialized/rulemaking/latest.json` names
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | The agency the cell covers; NULL for all agencies together. |
| `stratum` | `VARCHAR` | The rules counted: `all`, `routine`, `non_routine`, or one routine family. |
| `rules` | `INTEGER` | Lifecycles in the cell with a survival outcome. |
| `finals` | `INTEGER` | How many of them became final. |
| `withdrawals` | `INTEGER` | How many of them were withdrawn. |
| `censored` | `INTEGER` | How many of them were still open at `censor_date`. |
| `suppressed` | `BOOLEAN` | Whether the cell has fewer than 30 rules and so carries no estimates. |
| `q1_days` | `INTEGER` | First day the cumulative incidence of a final reaches 25%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed. |
| `q1_lower_days` | `INTEGER` | Lower end of the 95% interval of `q1_days`: the first day the band's upper edge reaches 25%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed. |
| `q1_upper_days` | `INTEGER` | Upper end of the 95% interval of `q1_days`: the first day the band's lower edge reaches 25%; NULL where it never does. |
| `median_days` | `INTEGER` | First day the cumulative incidence of a final reaches 50%: the median time to final; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed. |
| `median_lower_days` | `INTEGER` | Lower end of the 95% interval of `median_days`: the first day the band's upper edge reaches 50%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed. |
| `median_upper_days` | `INTEGER` | Upper end of the 95% interval of `median_days`; NULL where the band's lower edge never reaches 50%. |
| `q3_days` | `INTEGER` | First day the cumulative incidence of a final reaches 75%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed. |
| `q3_lower_days` | `INTEGER` | Lower end of the 95% interval of `q3_days`: the first day the band's upper edge reaches 75%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed. |
| `q3_upper_days` | `INTEGER` | Upper end of the 95% interval of `q3_days`; NULL where the band's lower edge never reaches 75%. |
| `censor_date` | `DATE` | The lifecycles' censor date, where the estimates' open rules are censored. |
